hypothesis: Can a private persistent index reuse every unchanged local message and embed only messages added or changed since the previous run?

cache_contract.model_change: fail closed and rebuild all vectors

incremental_catch_up.explanation: three new live visible Codex messages plus one explicit safe fixture

decision: Accept private persistent incremental caching for the desktop MVP. Cold construction remains expensive but occurs once; unchanged starts reuse all vectors and new messages alone are embedded.
claim_boundary: This is one real Linux Codex development run. It does not yet prove crash recovery, concurrent writers, macOS/Windows behavior or packaged-app upgrades. The cache contains embeddings, which remain private sensitive local data even though plaintext is absent.
